title: Vietnam draft lottery as IV for military service on earnings

llm_response.content:
## 1. Identification Strategy
- Method: Instrumental Variables (2SLS)
- Logic: Vietnam draft lottery numbers were randomly assigned. Men with low lottery numbers were more likely to serve, making low draft numbers a relevant and plausibly exogenous instrument for veteran status.
- Estimand: LATE of military service on log annual earnings for compliers (men whose service decision is affected by having a low draft number).
- Key assumptions:
  - Relevance: Low draft numbers increase the probability/intensity of military service (first-stage effect > 0).
  - Independence: Lottery numbers are randomly assigned and independent of earnings potential and other unobservables.
  - Exclusion: Lottery numbers affect earnings only through military service (no other direct channels).
  - Monotonicity: No defiers (no one is less likely to serve because they received a low draft number).
  - SUTVA: No interference and stable treatment.

## 2. R Code
```r
# Packages
if (!requireNamespace("AER", quietly = TRUE)) install.packages("AER")
if (!requireNamespace("sandwich", quietly = TRUE)) install.packages("sandwich")
if (!requireNamespace("lmtest", quietly = TRUE)) install.packages("lmtest")

library(AER)
library(sandwich)
library(lmtest)

# 1) Read data
df <- read.csv("experiments/exp_b/data/s21_data.csv")

# Basic sanity checks
stopifnot(all(c("y","x","z","controls") %in% names(df)))
N <- nrow(df)

# 2) Construct a binary instrument: low draft number
# If z already binary (e.g., 0/1), use it. Otherwise, define "low" as the bottom third of the lottery numbers.
uz <- sort(unique(df$z))
if (all(uz %in% c(0,1))) {
  df$low_z <- as.integer(df$z)
  cut_info <- "Instrument z is already binary; using z as low_z."
} else if (max(df$z, na.rm = TRUE) > 1) {
  cutoff <- as.numeric(quantile(df$z, probs = 1/3, na.rm = TRUE))
  df$low_z <- as.integer(df$z <= cutoff)
  cut_info <- paste0("Instrument constructed as low_z = 1{z <= ", round(cutoff,1), "} (bottom tercile).")
} else {
  # Fallback if z is not cleanly recognized
  medz <- median(df$z, na.rm = TRUE)
  df$low_z <- as.integer(df$z <= medz)
  cut_info <- paste0("Instrument constructed as low_z = 1{z <= median(z)=", round(medz,2), "}.")
}

# Report basic instrument split and naive differences
p_low <- mean(df$low_z, na.rm = TRUE)
dx_naive <- with(df, mean(x[low_z==1], na.rm=TRUE) - mean(x[low_z==0], na.rm=TRUE))
dy_naive <- with(df, mean(y[low_z==1], na.rm=TRUE) - mean(y[low_z==0], na.rm=TRUE))

# 3) First stage: x on instrument + controls
fs <- lm(x ~ low_z + controls, data = df)
fs_ct <- coeftest(fs, vcov = vcovHC(fs, type = "HC1"))
fs_b <- unname(fs_ct["low_z","Estimate"])
fs_se <- unname(fs_ct["low_z","Std. Error"])
fs_t <- unname(fs_ct["low_z","t value"])
fs_p <- unname(fs_ct["low_z","Pr(>|t|)"])
fs_F_robust <- as.numeric(fs_t^2)

# 4) Reduced form: y on instrument + controls
rf <- lm(y ~ low_z + controls, data = df)
rf_ct <- coeftest(rf, vcov = vcovHC(rf, type = "HC1"))
rf_b <- unname(rf_ct["low_z","Estimate"])
rf_se <- unname(rf_ct["low_z","Std. Error"])

# 5) 2SLS: y on x (endog), instrumented by low_z, with controls
iv <- AER::ivreg(y ~ x + controls | low_z + controls, data = df)
iv_ct <- coeftest(iv, vcov = vcovHC(iv, type = "HC1"))
iv_b <- unname(iv_ct["x","Estimate"])
iv_se <- unname(iv_ct["x","Std. Error"])
iv_t <- unname(iv_ct["x","t value"])
iv_p <- unname(iv_ct["x","Pr(>|t|)"])
iv_ci <- c(iv_b - 1.96*iv_se, iv_b + 1.96*iv_se)

# 6) Naive OLS for comparison
ols <- lm(y ~ x + controls, data = df)
ols_ct <- coeftest(ols, vcov = vcovHC(ols, type = "HC1"))
ols_b <- unname(ols_ct["x","Estimate"])
ols_se <- unname(ols_ct["x","Std. Error"])

# 7) Robustness checks
# 7a) 2SLS without controls
iv_nc <- AER::ivreg(y ~ x | low_z, data = df)
iv_nc_ct <- coeftest(iv_nc, vcov = vcovHC(iv_nc, type = "HC1"))
iv_nc_b <- unname(iv_nc_ct["x","Estimate"])
iv_nc_se <- unname(iv_nc_ct["x","Std. Error"])

# 7b) 2SLS with quadratic in controls
df$controls2 <- df$controls^2
iv_poly <- AER::ivreg(y ~ x + controls + controls2 | low_z + controls + controls2, data = df)
iv_poly_ct <- coeftest(iv_poly, vcov = vcovHC(iv_poly, type = "HC1"))
iv_poly_b <- unname(iv_poly_ct["x","Estimate"])
iv_poly_se <- unname(iv_poly_ct["x","Std. Error"])

# 7c) Balance test: controls on instrument
bal <- lm(controls ~ low_z, data = df)
bal_ct <- coeftest(bal, vcov = vcovHC(bal, type = "HC1"))
bal_b <- unname(bal_ct["low_z","Estimate"])
bal_p <- unname(bal_ct["low_z","Pr(>|t|)"])

# 8) Print key results
cat("Vietnam Draft IV Analysis\n")
cat("--------------------------------------------------\n")
cat("Sample size (N):", N, "\n")
cat(cut_info, "\n")
cat("Share with low draft number (low_z=1):", round(p_low, 3), "\n")
cat("Naive first-stage (mean x|low - mean x|high):", round(dx_naive, 4), "\n")
cat("Naive reduced form (mean y|low - mean y|high):", round(dy_naive, 4), "\n")
cat("--------------------------------------------------\n")
cat("First stage (x ~ low_z + controls):\n")
cat("  Coef on low_z:", round(fs_b, 4), "Robust SE:", round(fs_se, 4),
    "Robust t:", round(fs_t, 2), "Robust F (1, .):", round(fs_F_robust, 2),
    "p-value:", signif(fs_p, 3), "\n")
cat("--------------------------------------------------\n")
cat("Reduced form (y ~ low_z + controls):\n")
cat("  Coef on low_z:", round(rf_b, 4), "Robust SE:", round(rf_se, 4), "\n")
cat("--------------------------------------------------\n")
cat("2SLS (y ~ x | low_z), with controls:\n")
cat("  IV coef on x:", round(iv_b, 4), "Robust SE:", round(iv_se, 4),
    "t:", round(iv_t, 2), "p-value:", signif(iv_p, 3), "\n")
cat("  95% CI for IV coef:", paste0("[", round(iv_ci[1],4), ", ", round(iv_ci[2],4), "]"), "\n")
cat("--------------------------------------------------\n")
cat("Naive OLS (y ~ x + controls):\n")
cat("  OLS coef on x:", round(ols_b, 4), "Robust SE:", round(ols_se, 4), "\n")
cat("--------------------------------------------------\n")
cat("Robustness checks:\n")
cat("  2SLS without controls - coef on x:", round(iv_nc_b, 4), "SE:", round(iv_nc_se, 4), "\n")
cat("  2SLS with controls + controls^2 - coef on x:", round(iv_poly_b, 4), "SE:", round(iv_poly_se, 4), "\n")
cat("  Balance (controls ~ low_z): coef on low_z:", round(bal_b, 4), "p-value:", signif(bal_p, 3), "\n")
cat("--------------------------------------------------\n")
```

## 3. Expected Findings
- Sign: Negative IV effect. Military service likely reduces long-run civilian earnings by interrupting human capital accumulation and experience.
- Magnitude: Approximately -0.05 to -0.15 in log earnings (a 5–15% decrease) for compliers. OLS may be closer to zero or even less negative due to selection into service; IV should capture the causal effect induced by the lottery.
- Diagnostics: A strong first stage (robust F > 10) supports relevance; balance tests should show no significant correlation between the instrument and controls. Robustness across specifications (with/without controls, adding controls^2) should preserve the negative sign and similar magnitude.

_ground_truth.identification_strategy: IV/2SLS — instrument: draft lottery number; LATE for compliers (drafted but wouldn't have volunteered)
_ground_truth.conclusion_detail: Military service reduces earnings for complier veterans
